BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS course_version (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    course_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES course(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    tech_version_id integer NULL REFERENCES tech_version(id),
    status smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    compose_config_id uuid NULL REFERENCES compose_config(id),
    is_default boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    is_deprecated boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    published_at timestamptz NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS course_version_i18n (
    course_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES course_version(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    i18n_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES i18n(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    title varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    description text NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (course_version_id, i18n_id)
);

ALTER TABLE lesson ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS course_id uuid NULL REFERENCES course(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
ALTER TABLE lesson ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS course_version_id uuid NULL REFERENCES course_version(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
ALTER TABLE task ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS course_version_id uuid NULL REFERENCES course_version(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;

WITH picked_course AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (l.id)
        l.id AS lesson_id,
        cm.course_id
    FROM lesson l
    JOIN module_section ms ON ms.section_id = l.section_id
    JOIN course_module cm ON cm.module_id = ms.module_id
    ORDER BY l.id, cm."order", ms."order"
)
INSERT INTO course_version (course_id, tech_version_id, status, is_default, created_at, published_at)
SELECT DISTINCT ON (pc.course_id)
    pc.course_id,
    lv.tech_version_id,
    1,
    true,
    now(),
    now()
FROM picked_course pc
LEFT JOIN lesson_version lv ON lv.lesson_id = pc.lesson_id
ORDER BY pc.course_id, lv.created_at DESC NULLS LAST
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

WITH picked_course AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (l.id)
        l.id AS lesson_id,
        cm.course_id
    FROM lesson l
    JOIN module_section ms ON ms.section_id = l.section_id
    JOIN course_module cm ON cm.module_id = ms.module_id
    ORDER BY l.id, cm."order", ms."order"
)
UPDATE lesson l
SET course_id = pc.course_id,
    course_version_id = cv.id
FROM picked_course pc
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (course_id) id, course_id
    FROM course_version
    ORDER BY course_id, is_default DESC, created_at DESC
) cv ON cv.course_id = pc.course_id
WHERE l.id = pc.lesson_id;

UPDATE task t
SET course_version_id = l.course_version_id
FROM lesson l
WHERE l.id = t.lesson_id;

INSERT INTO course_version_i18n (course_version_id, i18n_id, title, description)
SELECT
    cv.id,
    ci.i18n_id,
    ci.title,
    ci.description
FROM course_version cv
JOIN course_i18n ci ON ci.course_id = cv.course_id
ON CONFLICT (course_version_id, i18n_id) DO NOTHING;

DROP INDEX IF EXISTS task_lesson_order_unique_idx;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS lesson_section_order_unique_idx;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS lesson_course_order_unique_idx
    ON lesson (course_id, "order");
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS task_course_version_lesson_order_unique_idx
    ON task (course_version_id, lesson_id, "order");

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lesson_course_version (
    lesson_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES lesson(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    course_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES course_version(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY (lesson_id, course_version_id)
);

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS lesson_version;
ALTER TABLE lesson DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS section_id;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS module_section;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS course_module;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS section_i18n;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS section;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS module_i18n;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS module;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS course_i18n;

COMMIT;
